Hi Kimberly,

We reviewed the draft term sheet and want to confirm ops details for the annual prepay (RDW-2384). Specifically:

- Can you lay out the invoice cadence you expect (one upfront invoice vs. tranching)?
- How do we trigger drawdowns from the escrow/retainer (milestone vs. burn thresholds)?
- What VAT evidence do you need from our side for EU invoices?

We have an internal request to align billing with our finance quarter close (Aug 1). Attaching our PO for reference.

Alex Turner

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Annual prepay cadence and escrow/unlock mechanics

Alex — thanks for the PO and the clear asks. Summary / proposal below.

1) Invoice cadence
- Proposal: 1x upfront invoice for the committed amount (prepay) issued on activation date, followed by quarterly drawdown reconciliation files that reflect consumption against the committed balance.
- If BrightCrate prefers tranche billing, we can convert to three equal invoices (activation / +90d / +180d) — confirm preference.

2) Escrow / unlock triggers
- Unlock model we typically use: automatic monthly withdraws against committed balance based on usage thresholds, with a manual milestone release for large one-off credits.
- Default triggers: monthly consumption > 10% of committed balance AND > $25k materiality — then auto-withdraw from the retainer.
- We will provide a monthly drawdown report (CSV) and a ledger statement for audit.

3) VAT / EU evidence
- For EU commercial customers we require: valid VAT registration copy + PO referencing local entity. If VAT reverse charge applies, we need the invoice-level VAT flag and your VAT number.
- If BrightCrate prefers to receive net-of-VAT invoices, please send the EU_VAT_Form.pdf (attached) completed by your tax team.

I've attached a Redwood invoice template (Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx) and a sample drawdown CSV.

Next steps:
- Please confirm (a) invoice cadence (single upfront vs tranches) and (b) whether we should enable automatic monthly drawdowns or manual approvals.
- If you confirm upfront invoice and auto-drawdown, we can issue first invoice on Aug 1 to match your close.

If agreeable, I'll loop in Jonas for ledger tagging and Karthik for the VAT mapping.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
